title: نجمة ليلى
logline: فتاةٌ تحبّ النجوم تعيد نجمةً تائهةً إلى السماء بنور فانوسها.
artStyle: Painterly cinematic night film: deep blue moonlit skies, warm amber lantern light, soft volumetric haze, Levantine mountain village textures.

cast.name: ليلى
cast.look: eight-year-old Levantine girl, warm olive skin, round face, long black hair in a single thick braid, large dark-brown eyes, indigo wool dress over a cream shirt, saffron-yellow headscarf, small brass lantern with amber glass

cast.name: الثعلب الصغير
cast.look: small red fox cub, russet fur with a cream chest, white-tipped bushy tail, bright amber eyes, one torn left ear, a thin blue thread tied around its neck

cast.name: النجمة
cast.look: a small fallen star, a glowing five-pointed crystal the size of a melon, pale gold-white light, soft blue halo, two tiny teardrop sparks under its centre

locations.name: سطح البيت
locations.look: flat earthen rooftop of a stone house in a mountain-foot village, clay water jars and a washing line, deep blue night sky crowded with stars, cool moonlight from the upper right, warm amber window glow below

locations.name: التلال
locations.look: rocky hills beyond the village, silent oak trees, grey boulders, dry grass, a winding goat path

shots.narration: في قريةٍ صغيرةٍ عند سفحِ الجبل، عاشت فتاةٌ اسمُها ليلى، تُحبُّ النجوم.
shots.visual: A tiny stone village sleeps at the foot of a dark mountain under a sky crowded with stars; on one flat rooftop at the right third, Layla is a small figure sitting with her lantern.
shots.action: 0–5s stars twinkle; a thin smoke curl rises from a chimney; the lantern glow flickers.
shots.light: cool moonlight from upper right, warm lantern point

shots.narration: كانت كلَّ ليلةٍ تصعدُ إلى سطحِ بيتِها، وتعدُّ النجومَ واحدةً واحدة.
shots.visual: Layla sits cross-legged at the left third of the rooftop, face tilted up, one finger pointing at the stars; the lantern rests beside her knee, clay jars behind her.
shots.action: 0–2s her finger moves from star to star; 3s she smiles; ambient: washing line sways.
shots.light: warm lantern key from left, cold moonlight rim

shots.narration: وفي ليلةٍ صافية، رأت نجمةً تسقطُ خلفَ التلالِ البعيدة.
shots.visual: Layla stands up at the left third, lantern in her right hand, staring past the frame edge toward the far hills; her braid swings behind her.
shots.action: 0–1s she rises; 2s her eyes widen; ambient: stars twinkle.
shots.light: warm lantern key from left, cold moonlight rim

shots.narration: فحملت ليلى فانوسَها، وانطلقت مع صديقِها الثعلبِ الصغيرِ نحو التلال.
shots.visual: Wide view of the moonlit goat path climbing the hills; Layla walks from left to right with the lantern held forward, the fox trotting a step ahead of her.
shots.action: 0–5s they walk left to right; the lantern swings; ambient: grass bends in the breeze.
shots.light: cool silver moonlight from upper right, warm lantern pool

shots.narration: وتذكّرت تحذيرَ جدّتِها من الذئاب، لكنها مضت، ومشيا طويلاً بين الأشجارِ الصامتة.
shots.visual: Layla and the fox pass between two dark oak trunks, the girl glancing back over her shoulder; the lantern lights the bark in amber.
shots.action: 0–4s they walk deeper; 2s she glances back; ambient: leaves tremble.
shots.light: warm lantern key, deep blue shadows

shots.narration: حتى وجدا النجمةَ الصغيرةَ تبكي بين الصخور، وقالت النجمةُ بصوتٍ مرتجفٍ إنها فقدت طريقَها إلى السماء، وإنها لا تعرفُ كيف تعودُ إلى أخواتِها، وإن الليلَ طويلٌ والبردَ شديد.
shots.visual: Between two grey boulders the small star glows on the ground, two teardrop sparks under it; Layla kneels at the left, lantern lowered, the fox's nose close to the light.
shots.action: 0–4s the star pulses dimly; spark-tears drip; ambient: dust floats in its glow.
shots.light: pale gold glow from below, warm lantern from left

shots.narration: ففكّرت ليلى قليلاً، ثم رفعت فانوسَها عالياً ليضيءَ الطريق.
shots.visual: Layla stands on a boulder at the center, right arm raised high with the lantern, its amber light spilling up into the night; the star hovers at her shoulder, the fox looks up.
shots.action: 0–2s she lifts the lantern high; 2–4s the light blooms upward; ambient: haze glows.
shots.light: strong amber lantern key from above, moonlight rim

shots.narration: فطارت النجمةُ صاعدةً مع نورِ الفانوس، حتى عادت إلى مكانِها بين أخواتِها. ومنذ تلك الليلة، صار في السماءِ نجمةٌ تلمعُ أكثرَ من غيرِها كلما نظرت إليها ليلى.
shots.visual: Tiny figures of Layla and the fox on the hilltop at the bottom third look up as a bright point climbs into the crowded sky and settles among the stars.
shots.action: 0–6s the bright point rises and settles; 7s it flares once; ambient: stars twinkle.
shots.light: moonlight and starlight, one bright star
